structural_growth_runway.rationale: MAUs grew 11% and Premium subscribers 9% year over year; product expansion, pricing and creator monetization provide additional runway, subject to competition and execution.

financial_quality.rationale: Nine-month operating income reached EUR 2.042 billion and free cash flow EUR 2.356 billion; cash plus short-term investments were EUR 9.888 billion after settlement of the exchangeable notes.

business_risk_and_governance.rationale: Royalty and licensing economics, advertising cyclicality, FX, competition, content regulation and share-based compensation remain material risks; current official filings show adequate liquidity and no evidence that invalidates research eligibility.

circle_of_competence.rationale: User confirmation of streaming royalty economics and platform competition remains a pre-trade layer and does not block daily research ranking.

valuation.rationale: Subscriber and MAU growth, improving operating income and free cash flow support growth; royalty economics, advertising cyclicality, competition, FX and SBC justify 8%/13% analyst growth scenarios and conservative cash conversion.

normalization_bridge.formula: (FY25 diluted EPS EUR 10.51 + 9M26 diluted EPS EUR 8.54 - 9M25 diluted EPS EUR 4.93) × disclosed Q3 repurchase USD/EUR conversion (367/318)
normalization_bridge.limitations: Translation uses the issuer-disclosed Q3 share-repurchase conversion as a reproducible approximation, not a spot FX quote; IFRS EPS includes finance and tax volatility. No cash addition to the equity denominator.

valuation_model.rationale: Subscriber and MAU growth, improving operating income and free cash flow support growth; royalty economics, advertising cyclicality, competition, FX and SBC justify 8%/13% analyst growth scenarios and conservative cash conversion.

source_review.conclusion: Q3 2026 6-K and issuer IR establish current quality, cash-flow and TTM EPS inputs.
